text:
Josh Morrissey missed about a month after leaving an Oct. 7 game against Colorado, and since returning on Nov. 10 the Jets haven't eased him in. He played 32.8 minutes in a comeback win over Chicago and scored on Thursday in an overtime win over the Islanders, a night the Jets' own highlight package titled "Morrissey the hero!"

Nine games is a small sample, so read these lightly. He has 6 points, a reasonable rate for him, and Winnipeg has scored 9.2 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, which is a lot of good fortune in a short stretch. At five on five the Jets are slightly outchanced with him out there (46.5% of expected goals).

The bigger picture is last season. Evolving-Hockey had him 17th among 215 defensemen in wins above replacement, most of it from even-strength offense, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 86th percentile among defensemen for primary shot assists. Watch whether his on-ice chances catch up with the scoreboard.
headline: Morrissey's back, and Winnipeg leans on him
